scope: Be the most useful independent visitor and museum-understanding guide; NOT a duplicate of museum-owned collections, archives, artifact inventories or curatorial databases.

rules.decision: Certify only after direct side-by-side comparison finds no material visitor-planning gaps versus the institution's published visitor guidance, the TexasDefined guide adds independent visitor value, specific exhibit highlights are accurate and brief, the FAQ is researched beyond the operator's FAQ and photos/links/technical QA pass. The museum remains the source of truth for live operations.

operatorStrengths: Museum-operated Texas history gallery coverage, La Belle and changing exhibit information
Interpretive chronology and collection-related research
openGaps: Confirm current Story of Texas Café service and visitor parking specifics, not merely historic marketing
Add distinct gallery highlight blurbs and visitor routes aligned to current galleries
Verify practical family and accessibility FAQ questions beyond museum tickets
